versions.content: If CanIf_ControllerErrorStatePassive() is called by CanDrv , the CanIf shall report the security event CANIF_SEV_ERRORSTATE_PAS- SIVE in following cases: • TxErrorCounter > 127 and TxErrorCounter <= 255 • RxErrorCounter > 127 and TxErrorCounter <= 255 The context data is structured as follows: Context Data (2 Byte) • ControllerID (1 Byte) • ErrorCounterThreshold (1 Byte) – TxErrorCounter > 127 AND RxErrorCounter > 127(0x0) – TxErrorCounter > 127 AND RxErrorCounter < 127 (0x1) – RxErrorCounter > 127 AND TxErrorCounter < 127 (0x2)
